## Canonical product rule

Cognita is a commercial private non-degree professional training and competency-development business.

Primary objective:
**sustainable revenue and profit.**

Canonical flow:
**Create Account → CEE → Profile → Gap Analysis → Personalized Path → Recommended Mode → Paid Offer → Training → Mastery → Evidence → Credential → Next Paid Path**

Do not restore application-first, invitation-only CEE, pass/fail-first, or account-after-payment logic.

## CEE

CEE = Cognita Entry & Competency Evaluation.

It is the diagnostic, personalization, routing, and paid-offer recommendation engine.

The Learner Readiness & Support Profile is non-clinical.

Do not present it as a psychological exam or diagnose psychological/mental-health conditions.

## Commercial model

Cognita recommends first rather than making the learner guess from a course catalog.

Self-Paced = flexible lower-touch paid route.
Guided = premium route for learners who benefit from structure/accountability/feedback.
Organizations = assessment-led cohort/institutional route.

Use ethical conversion psychology only. No fabricated scarcity, fake outcomes, hidden fees, or vulnerability-based pricing.

## Legal

Cognita is a private, non-degree provider.

Do not claim CHED, DepEd, TESDA, PRC, government accreditation/certification, academic credit, or licensing unless actually obtained and specifically applicable.

## Frontend-only

Do not represent local simulations as production account registration, CEE submission, payment, authentication, records, or credential issuance.

Use the committed Cognita brand system for all visual work.
